title: Bubba delivers!!!
text: Bubba delivers!!!. Love this insulated cup. Its now over 24 hours since I put ice in it and even though the ice has finally melted my water is still ice cold. I filled it partially with ice and just kept adding cold water all day. Was so impressed with this cup that I came back for 2 more has gifts for my girls. Bottom line.... Bubba delivers!!!

product_metadata.title: Bubba Envy S Vacuum-Insulated Stainless Steel Tumbler with Lid and Straw, 24oz Reusable Iced Coffee or Water Cup, BPA-Free Travel Tumbler, Island Teal
features: Dual-wall vacuum-insulated stainless steel keeps drinks cold up to 12 hours without sweating
Removable, easy-clean lid can be used with or without plastic straw
BPA-free lid is made of superior impact-, stain-, and odor-resistant plastic
Silicone base pad to prevent sliding
Top-rack dishwasher-safe lid; hand-wash-only stainless steel body
description: Need to chill? Look no further than the dual-wall bubba Envy S Vacuum-Insulated Stainless Steel Tumbler with Straw, 24 oz., which keeps your favorite drink cold up to 12 hours without condensation, letting you hold on comfortably. The BPA-free lid is made of superior stain- and odor-resistant plastic so you won’t have to worry about lingering stains or odors when you switch beverages, and it features a smooth lip so you can effortlessly switch from drinking with or without the plastic straw. Road trip? You’ll be happy to know that your tumbler easily fits most car cup holders, and the silicone base pad prevents slipping and sliding on other surfaces. At the end of the day, throw the lid and straw onto the top rack of your dishwasher for a no-fuss cleanup, but remember to hand-wash the body. Rest assured..
